argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.9-10.1: Present precise claims distinguished from opposing claims; develop both fairly with evidence and strengths/limitations, anticipating audience knowledge/concerns; connect sections, maintain formal objective style and conclude.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.9-10.1: Use parallel structures and varied phrases/clauses for meaning and interest.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.9-10.2: Use semicolons and colons appropriately with correct spelling/capitalization.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.9-10.3: Use a consistent appropriate style manual where the task requires it.
